Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG character overlay for short video templates
Primary request: Simple minimalist stick figure girl with a ponytail, black line art, white filled round face, friendly face, same minimalist stick figure style.
Style: simple flat 2D vector-like illustration, bold clean dark outlines, few solid contrasting colors, legible at small overlay size.
Composition: single isolated character, full body front view looking directly at camera, upright neutral idle pose, arms down or slightly open, hands empty. Centered in a portrait 4:5 canvas, generous transparent margins, entire silhouette visible.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background. No ground, no scenery, no cast shadow, no text, no watermark, no props. One character only.
